thread:
Alex K: handing off for the afternoon. quick summary — regen latency spike at ~14:10, scaled regen pool and flipped routing fallback; embed-cache eviction rate elevated, investigating. what i did / blockers / next steps:

Maria R: saw the spike in traces too. lots of tail latency from cache misses. pushed a hotfix to prefer local KV reads for 30m. PR #4123. monitoring now. :eyes:

Oncall Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-488 — regen-latency-spike. severity: medium. linked dashboards: https://dash.redwood/regen-latency

Jamal P: scaled regenerator up: `kubectl scale deployment/regenerator --replicas=20 -n prod` and bumped hpa min for the group. latency dropped ~30% after that.

Sasha T: i'll take the embed cache investigation. planning heap dump + GC logs at 16:00 on two high-eviction nodes. cc @Maria R for KV read patch validation.

Alex K: blocker — embed-store eviction rate still ~0.6%/min on node pool embed-ssd-2. if it keeps >0.5% we'll need to add a node or reduce batch ingestion. i've lowered ingestion priority for now.

Lee H: i've got the pager for the next 4h. dashboard pinned here: https://dash.redwood/embeds/evictions. set alert: `embeds.eviction_rate > 0.5` -> page. :white_check_mark:

Maria R: quick Q — should we enable warmstart on the new embed nodes? should reduce cold-start misses.

Alex K: yes, enable warmstart. added annotation to the deployment: `service.redwood/warmstart: enabled`. also added a short play: if eviction_rate > 0.8 then scale embed-cache +1 and notify infra.

Jamal P: adding the playbook step now to runbook: `if embeds.eviction_rate > 0.5 then scale +1; if >0.8 then escalate to oncall lead` and posted to docs.

Sasha T: running heap dumps at 16:00. i'll post notes and a link to the heap artifact here when done.

Oncall Bot: INC-2026-488 — regen latency trending back to baseline after scale and routing fallback. latest: 14:42 recovery delta -55%. Marking as 'monitoring' (not closed).

Alex K: leaving: follow-ups for next oncall — 1) confirm warmstart reduces cold misses 2) root cause for embed evictions (heap/GC vs eviction policy) 3) consider longer-term autoscale tweak for embed pool. ping me if anything spikes. :raised_hands:
